params.command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
& wsl.exe -d Ubuntu -- docker exec heaven-worker-01 sh -lc 'echo worker01 > /workspace/isolation-proof'
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'worker01 write failed'}
& wsl.exe -d Ubuntu -- docker exec heaven-worker-02 sh -lc 'test ! -e /workspace/isolation-proof'
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'workspace isolation failed'}
Write-Output 'ISOLATION_OK'
& wsl.exe -d Ubuntu -- docker exec heaven-worker-03 sh -lc 'echo SHARED_OK > /shared/shared-proof'
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'shared write failed'}
$shared=(& wsl.exe -d Ubuntu -- docker exec heaven-worker-04 sh -lc 'cat /shared/shared-proof' | Out-String).Trim()
if($shared -ne 'SHARED_OK'){throw "shared exchange failed: $shared"}
Write-Output 'SHARED_OK'
$base=(& wsl.exe -d Ubuntu -- docker inspect heaven-worker-01 --format '{{.HostConfig.NanoCpus}}|{{.HostConfig.Memory}}|{{.HostConfig.PidsLimit}}' | Out-String).Trim()
$burst=(& wsl.exe -d Ubuntu -- docker inspect heaven-worker-05 --format '{{.HostConfig.NanoCpus}}|{{.HostConfig.Memory}}|{{.HostConfig.PidsLimit}}|{{.State.Status}}' | Out-String).Trim()
Write-Output "BASE_LIMITS=$base"
Write-Output "BURST_LIMITS=$burst"
$ports=(& wsl.exe -d Ubuntu -- docker port heaven-worker-01 2>&1 | Out-String).Trim()
if($ports){throw "published ports found: $ports"}
Write-Output 'NO_PUBLISHED_PORTS'
$mounts=(& wsl.exe -d Ubuntu -- docker inspect heaven-worker-01 --format '{{range .Mounts}}{{.Type}}:{{.Destination}}:{{.RW}};{{end}}' | Out-String).Trim()
Write-Output "MOUNTS=$mounts"
& wsl.exe -d Ubuntu -- docker stats --no-stream --format '{{.Name}}|{{.MemUsage}}|{{.PIDs}}' heaven-worker-01 heaven-worker-02 heaven-worker-03 heaven-worker-04
exit $LASTEXITCODE
